decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core cutting and creasing offer, it is inexpensive to keep available and after only one year the option value is still higher than the case for abandonment.

Although the UV spot varnishing system is more distant from the established range and therefore riskier, its flagship positioning means management would likely keep it on the market a bit longer to learn whether the adjacent enhancement opportunity pays off.

Because the sheet preparation module builds directly on the existing postpress portfolio, it fits current customer workflows and can be retained at low incremental cost while demand uncertainty resolves.
The B2 multifinisher is both close to the firm's established business and presented as a strategic focus product, so real-options logic strongly favors continuing rather than closing it early.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits within the firm's familiar booklet and binding domain, and with no negative market signal visible there is little reason to give up this option so soon after launch.

The folding add-on unit appears to have at least one reference installation and, as a small complementary add-on to the installed base, is relatively cheap to keep in the portfolio while its broader sales potential becomes clearer.
